credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Amorphophallus titanum, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amorphophallus_titanum . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Amorphophallus titanum. LOOMING-lite: the titan arum's single giant leaf, a little tree: a tall, thick, mottled and speckled stalk rising in a C from the corm, splitting into arms that carry an umbrella of pointed leaflets, the lead arm reaching out over the foe and the rear leaflets in the dark slot behind. Gesture: the leaf sways (the umbrella winds back, swings over the foe, holds, rebounds and settles); the corm and soil stay fixed. A maroon-brown dark slot (the corm's shade and skin marks, the stalk's blotches, the spathe's inside) under a mid that turns from olive (corm and leaf) to cream-yellow (the spadix and the spathe's pale outside). Skin marks and blotches always join an edge or the shade, never an enclosed dark dot. Sport: a pale form, an artistic interpretation (no pale titan arum is known).
